■ G-Neo Evolution: You may put this creature on top of one of your light, fire or nature creatures. (If a creature is under it, treat it as a Neo Evolution Creature, and when it would leave, all cards under it leave instead.)

■ Whenever one of your creatures wins a battle, look at the top card of your deck and put it into your hand or mana zone. Then untap all cards in your mana zone.
